validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED real, independent of GEM. The OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2017, Table 9.9 'Main gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2016' (p.136), Saudi Arabia section, lists 'Abqaiq/Shedgum - Saudi Aramco - 33 [miles] - 42 [inches]'. The ASB 2012 edition (Saudi gas pipelines table) lists the same line as 'Abqaiq-B/Shedgum - Saudi Aramco - 33 - 42' - the '-B' node label is exactly the source of GEM's name 'Abqaiq-B-Shedgum'. Both confirmed by direct pypdf text extraction of the PDFs (the wiki had cited these two ASB editions; the verifier reads r.text and cannot parse PDF tables, so it FAILs the token check on any PDF even when the token is genuinely present - URL resolution is OK/200 for both). CLASSIFICATION: CONFIRMED gas transmission line - it sits in the natural-gas pipelines table (Table 9.9), Saudi Aramco operator, NOT in the crude (6.9), product (6.10), or NGL tables; commodity 'Gas' is correct. Abqaiq and Shedgum are both major Aramco gas-processing complexes in the Eastern Province roughly 30-40 km apart, so a 53 km gas trunk between them is geographically coherent and consistent with the dense Abqaiq/Shedgum/Uthmaniyah/Hawiyah gas network. DUPLICATE: none - the ASB Saudi gas table maps 1:1 onto the GEM roster (UBTG-1/Berri to P1898/P1899, Abqaiq/Berri to P1906, Aindar/Shedgum to P1924, Depco/Abqaiq to P1925, etc.); P1913 is the single 'Abqaiq/Shedgum' row. No other roster row is the same physical pipe (P1924 Aindar-Shedgum is a different origin, 34 km, 12 in). SPEC: Diameter 42 in matches exactly; Length GEM 53.00 km = 33 miles in the ASB (33 mi = 53.1 km - GEM's value is the direct metric conversion); Owner Saudi Aramco matches; FuelSource 'Abqaiq' = start node, consistent; endpoints Abqaiq->Shedgum, Eastern Province, both confirmed. Capacity is genuinely blank - no independent figure found; left blank rather than fabricated. CAVEAT: the two corroborating references are two editions of the same OPEC publication, so this is one strong source lineage rather than two fully independent origins; no non-OPEC source gives this granular segment's specs (segment too fine for press coverage). Treated as medium-high single-family corroboration. Also note the wiki's own cited URLs (opec.org/opec_web/.../ASB2017_13062017.pdf and ASB2012.pdf) are now link-rotted - they 301-redirect to opec.org and then 403; recoverable only via the Wayback snapshots cited below.

fills.researcher_notes: OPEC ASB 2017 Table 9.9 (p.136) and ASB 2012 Saudi gas table both list Abqaiq/Shedgum at 33 miles = 53.1 km; GEM's 53.00 km is the metric conversion. URLs resolve OK/200; value presence confirmed by pypdf extraction (verifier cannot read PDF bodies).
Both OPEC ASB editions list the Abqaiq/Shedgum gas line at 42 inches - exact match to GEM. Confirmed via pypdf extraction of the cited table rows.

ASB 2017 Table 9.9 lists this as an existing/in-service main gas pipeline (2016 data); supports operating status. No source indicates retirement; a decades-old Aramco trunk between two active gas plants is operating.
Line appears in ASB Table 9.9 'Main gas pipelines' (natural gas chapter), not in the crude/product/NGL tables - confirms Fuel=Gas.

ASB row 'Abqaiq/Shedgum' gives both endpoints; both Abqaiq and Shedgum are Aramco gas-processing complexes in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. Endpoints and province confirmed; StartLocation 'Abqaiq' added (was blank but implied by name and source).

FuelSource 'Abqaiq' = the start node in the ASB 'Abqaiq/Shedgum' row, consistent with gas moving from the Abqaiq complex toward Shedgum. Low tier: the ASB confirms the endpoint label, not explicitly the upstream gas-source attribution.

Both ASB editions name 'Saudi Aramco' as owner/operator of the Abqaiq/Shedgum gas line; 100% Aramco ownership of domestic gas trunk infrastructure is consistent with Saudi Arabia's nationalized gas grid.

summary: P1913 Abqaiq-B-Shedgum gas pipeline CONFIRMED (caveat): real, correctly classified gas trunk; OPEC ASB 2017/2012 list 'Abqaiq(-B)/Shedgum, Saudi Aramco, 33 mi=53 km, 42 in' matching GEM exactly; caveat is single OPEC source-family and dead wiki URLs (refreplaced with Wayback copies); Capacity left blank.
